hebrewText: וְ/הוּא֙ מְחֹלָ֣ל מִ/פְּשָׁעֵ֔/נוּ מְדֻכָּ֖א מֵ/עֲוֺנֹתֵ֑י/נוּ מוּסַ֤ר שְׁלוֹמֵ֨/נוּ֙ עָלָ֔י/ו וּ/בַ/חֲבֻרָת֖/וֹ נִרְפָּא לָֽ/נוּ

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: properly, to bore, i.e. (by implication) to wound, to dissolve; figuratively, to profane (a person, place or thing), to break (one's word), to begin (as if by an 'opening wedge'); to play (the flute)
tokens.kjv: begin ([idiom] men began), defile, [idiom] break, defile, [idiom] eat (as common things), [idiom] first, [idiom] gather the grape thereof, [idiom] take inheritance, pipe, player on instruments, pollute, (cast as) profane (self), prostitute, slay (slain), sorrow, stain, wound.

tokens.bdb: to crumble; transitively, to bruise (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: beat to pieces, break (in pieces), bruise, contrite, crush, destroy, humble, oppress, smite.
fault, iniquity, mischeif, punishment (of iniquity), sin.

tokens.bdb: properly, chastisement; figuratively, reproof, warning or instruction; also restraint
tokens.kjv: bond, chastening(-eth), chastisement, check, correction, discipline, doctrine, instruction, rebuke.

tokens.bdb: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
tokens.kjv: [idiom] do, familiar, [idiom] fare, favour, [phrase] friend, [idiom] great, (good) health, ([idiom] perfect, such as be at) peace(-able, -ably), prosper(-ity, -ous), rest, safe(-ty), salute, welfare, ([idiom] all is, be) well, [idiom] wholly.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: properly, bound (with stripes), i.e. a weal (or black-and-blue mark itself)
properly, to mend (by stitching), i.e. (figuratively) to cure
tokens.kjv: cure, (cause to) heal, physician, repair, [idiom] thoroughly, make whole. See H7503 (רָפָה).
